'''June 2000 Helmond tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Helmond, Netherlands on 11 June 2000. [[Paul van Hoorne]] won it. It is known from Jeroen van den Bosch's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d937">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-26-helmond-netherlands-june-11thd937/ helmond-netherlands-june-11th], DeckTech (Jeroen "S.T.oma" van den Bosch, 26 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-26-helmond-netherlands-june-11thd937/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 11 June 2000
* '''Site:''' Helmond, Netherlands
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 14
* '''Winner:''' [[Paul van Hoorne]]
